parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` — `Playcut.stub` in `_Plant_PlaycutStub.swift` and `Breakpoint.stub` in `PlaylistStubs.swift` are test-fixture stub factories living under `Shared/Playlist/Sources/PlaylistTesting/`. Per the decision rules, any cluster where even one record is test-marked must default to no-action; here both records are test fixtures, making the restraint unambiguous. Collapsing these into a generic stub factory would couple test-fixture semantics to a shared production-visible utility, which is the canonical anti-pattern the restraint rule guards against.
